raucous:
Catching and losing, gaining and failing,
Raging me back at the world's raucous railing.
Simply and humbly from stone and from wood,
Only the constant jostling and the raucous ensemble of street noises served to bring her out of her daze.

I walked the road beside my dear.
The rooks went up with a raucous trill.
I hear them still, in the fall of the year.
His deep raucous voice had thrilled them as it uttered the word of belief and submission.
And as she climbed the stairs she could hear a drunken chorus of raucous masculine laughter.
